description: This file is a shell script for managing Git repository worktrees related to pull requests, including functions for entering the worktree, fetching PR metadata, writing metadata files, listing, and cleaning up PR worktrees.

methods.name: repo_root
methods.description: Determines the root directory of the repository by resolving the git common directory or fallback path.

methods.name: enter_worktree
methods.description: Switches the current directory to the specified pull request's worktree, fetching and checking out the main branch as needed.

methods.name: pr_meta_json
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON metadata for a specific pull request via GitHub CLI.

methods.name: write_pr_meta_files
methods.description: Writes PR metadata to JSON and environment variable files, escaping values to prevent injection.

methods.name: list_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Lists all existing PR worktrees along with their PR number, directory, and status info.

methods.name: gc_pr_worktrees
methods.description: Garbage collects (removes) PR worktrees that are merged or closed, with optional dry-run mode.

methods.name: pr_number_from_worktree_dir
methods.description: Extracts the PR number from a worktree directory name.
